title: Microbial DNA Enrichment of Rectal Mucosa Tissue Samples
author: Lee Murphy
materials: Samples can now be processed for library preparation using NEB NEBNext Ultra II FS DNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina with sequencing on the Illumina NextSeq2000.

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Buffers
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary buffers for DNA normalization and bead preparation.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Tris-EDTA Buffer pH7.5 by mixing 4 mL of 1M Tris-HCl pH7.5 and 800 µL of 0.5M EDTA pH 8 in 400 mL of distilled water.
Prepare 1X Bind/wash Buffer on ice by making a 1 in 5 dilution of NEBNext Bind/wash Buffer (5X) with DNase-free water (approx. 4 mL per reaction, or a 20 mL master mix for 48 reactions).

steps.title: Assess DNA Quality and Quantity
steps.instruction: Quantify and verify the size of the extracted DNA samples.

substeps.instruction: Quantify 2 µL of extracted DNA using a Qubit Flex Fluorometer with either the dsDNA Broad Range or High Sensitivity assay kit.

Determine DNA quality using an Agilent Fragment Analyzer with the Genomic DNA Kit (50kb) (#5191-6569) using 2 µL of sample; verify that DNA fragments are >15kb using PROsize Data Analysis Software (alternatively, use a 0.8% agarose gel).

steps.title: Normalize DNA Samples
steps.instruction: Adjust DNA concentrations to a standard input amount.

substeps.instruction: Normalize samples to 1 µg input DNA using the prepared Tris-EDTA Buffer pH7.5, ensuring a minimum final volume of 40 µL.
Retain at least 5 ng of DNA for later validation by qPCR.

steps.title: Prepare MBD2-Fc Protein-Bead Complex
steps.instruction: Prepare the magnetic beads for DNA enrichment.

substeps.instruction: Calculate the required volume of MBD2-Fc-bound magnetic beads (Y) using the equation: Y = Input DNA (ng) / 6.25 ng/µL (e.g., 160 µL beads for 1000 ng DNA).
Resuspend NEBNext Protein A Magnetic Beads by rotating gently for 15 minutes at 4 °C (do not vortex).
Prepare the protein-bead mixture: add 0.1x Y µL of MBD2-Fc protein and Y µL of Protein A Magnetic Beads per reaction (e.g., 16 µL protein and 160 µL beads for 1 µg input).
Mix by pipetting up and down at least 10 times, then rotate on a mixer for 10 minutes at Room Temperature.
Briefly spin the tubes and place on a magnetic rack for 5 minutes until the solution is clear.
Ensure batches of MBD beads have a minimum volume of 40 µL to allow adequate mixing.

steps.title: Perform DNA Enrichment
steps.instruction: Bind the DNA to the MBD2-Fc beads to separate human DNA from microbial DNA.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 1 µg input DNA in up to 200 µL DNase-free water or TE Buffer pH 7.5.
Add the calculated volume (Y) of MBD2-Fc-bound magnetic beads to the DNA sample.
Add undiluted Bind/wash Buffer (5X) to the mix for a final concentration of 1X (Volume of 5X buffer = Volume of input DNA / 4; e.g., 10 µL buffer for 40 µL DNA).
Pipette the sample up and down at least 10 times until beads are completely homogenous.
Agitate on a rotating mixer for 15 minutes at Room Temperature (if using a plate, pipette every 2 minutes).

steps.title: Wash and Recover Enriched DNA
steps.instruction: Wash the beads to remove unbound protein and collect the microbial DNA supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Place the tube/plate on a magnetic stand. If necessary, spin briefly first.

After 5 minutes (or when clear), carefully remove the supernatant with a pipette without disturbing the beads. Transfer this supernatant (enriched for microbial DNA) to a clean tube/plate; store at -20 °C or proceed to purification.
Wash the beads: add (Y) µL of 1X Bind/wash Buffer (kept on ice) to resuspend the beads, mix by pipetting, and rotate on a mixer for 3 minutes at Room Temperature.
Place on the magnetic rack for 5 minutes, then carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Repeat the wash process (adding 1 mL of 1X Bind/wash Buffer, mixing 10 times, and collecting on the magnet) twice more for a total of three washes.
Perform a final wash: add 200 µL of freshly prepared 70% ethanol, incubate for 1 minute at Room Temperature, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Purify Microbial DNA via Bead Clean-up
steps.instruction: Use AMPure XP beads to purify the collected microbial DNA supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Vortex AMPure XP beads to resuspend.
Add 1.8X volume of resuspended AMPure XP beads to the sample. Mix by pipetting 10 times and incubate at Room Temperature for 5 minutes.
Place on a magnetic stand for 5 minutes (or until clear), then transfer the eluate to a new tube/plate.
Resuspend the beads in 30 µL of 1X TE buffer (NEB #E7808AAVIAL), mixing by pipetting 10 times and incubating for at least 2 minutes at Room Temperature.
Wash the beads: add 200 µL of 70% ethanol, incubate for 1 minute, and discard the supernatant. Repeat this wash once more (total of two washes).

Air dry the beads for 1 minute on the magnetic stand with the lid open. Spin at full speed for 2 minutes to collect residual ethanol, place on the magnet for 30 seconds, remove ethanol, and air-dry for another 1 minute. (Do not over-dry; beads should remain dark brown and glossy).

steps.title: Validate Enrichment by qPCR
steps.instruction: Verify the efficiency of the enrichment using 16s and RPL30 primers.

substeps.instruction: Use 5 ng of input for both enriched and unenriched samples using Luna Universal qPCR Master Mix (NEBnext #M3003S).
Aliquot 9 µL of each sample (input and enriched) in triplicate into a 384-well plate for both 16s rRNA gene and RPL30 Human gene control primers (#E2612).
Add 0.25 µL of each 20 µM primer and 10 µL of Luna Universal qPCR Master Mix per sample (total volume ~20 µL).
Perform qPCR on a QuantStudio 12K Flex (Thermo Fisher).
Analyze results: successful enrichment is indicated by minimal change in Cq for 16s primers and a significant change in Cq for RPL30 human primers in enriched vs. unenriched samples.
